actionable_steps.citation: Rich Cultural Heritage of Bharat — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-17
actionable_steps.step: Declare to God, 'I am Yours' — offer yourself: body, mind and spirit, in total unity.

actionable_steps.citation: A new way of life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-03-29
actionable_steps.step: Give up your desires immediately — that is the first thing He asks of you.

actionable_steps.citation: The Gita Balance — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3 (1963), 1963-10-24
actionable_steps.step: Wish for His will to prevail, not for your wish to succeed — tell the Lord, 'You are enough for me.'
Place all your burdens on the Lord, like the kitten in the mother cat's mouth — follow Him ceaselessly and He will provide everything.

actionable_steps.citation: Not salaries but service — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-01
actionable_steps.step: Offer your heart to the Divine, not just flowers and fruits — 'I am offering to you the heart which you gave me.'

definition.citation: Rich Cultural Heritage of Bharat — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-17
definition.quote: What is the meaning of surrender? It is not giving something. It is to offer oneself. … Total surrender means the surrender of body, mind, and spirit.

discourses.citation: A new way of life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-03-29
discourses.quote: You must declare to God, "I am yours". This is the truth you have to understand. You must be ready to offer to God whatever He asks of you. What does God ask from you? First of all, He says, "Give up your desires." You must give them up immediately.

discourses.citation: The Gita Balance — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3 (1963), 1963-10-24
discourses.quote: The Gita teaches the lesson of unconditional surrender to the Lord (saranagathi). Wish for His will to prevail, not for your wish to succeed. … Surrender is the main gate to attain liberation.

discourses.citation: God: The trinity and the cosmos — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-02-28
discourses.quote: Total surrender is essential for Divine realisation. The path of direct realisation of the Divine consists in total surrender to the Divine, as exemplified by Lakshmana in his surrender to Rama.

discourses.citation: Manifesting Divinity in Lingodbhava — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-02-15
discourses.quote: You feel that arpitham (total surrender) to God is rather difficult, but according to Me, nothing is easier than this.

make_it_real: Surrender isn't giving up — it's giving over. Hand Him one worry today, and don't take it back.
title: Surrender (Prapatti)

vahinis.quote: The devotee places all burdens on the Lord and surrenders fully to His will. … The discipline of surrender (prapatthi) is much superior to that of devotion (bhakthi). The characteristic of surrender is complete self-surrender, in all aspects.
There are three types of self-surrender: I am Thine, Thou art mine, and Thou art I. The first affirms, I am Yours; the second asserts, You are mine; the third declares, You and I are One, the same.
